title: Add an interface compatibility step to change review
problem: Reviews approve changes that break the shared contract: removed, renamed and retyped fields pass because the procedure never compares the contract before and after.
hypothesis: If the review procedure compares the contract before and after the change, breaking interface changes will be blocked and review accuracy on fresh changes will rise.
expected_benefit: Fewer approved breaking changes; higher review accuracy.
possible_regressions: Safe changes could be blocked if the comparison is too eager
Each review runs one more step
change_summary: Adds validator interface_compat (top-level comparison of fields and types) and a procedure step that runs it.

procedure: Confirm the change adds or updates tests
Compare the contract before and after the change; any removed, renamed, retyped or added field is a blocking finding naming the field
Request changes if any check reports a blocking finding; otherwise approve
known_failure_cases: Treats every added field as breaking
